newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE TO OPEN IN RIGA EARLY MAY.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE TO OPEN IN RIGA EARLY MAY.

text.p: Estonian meat processor Rakvere meat plant will take its first step to export to the other Baltic states and Ukraine in early May by opening in Riga, the company's finance manager said on Friday.
He also said that the company, which had 1996 turnover of 547 million kroons and profit of two million kroons, expects to export 40 tonnes of meat products to the region by end 1997.

"In early May we will open our cold warehouse in Riga with a full selection of products and we expect to export 10 tonnes of meat products per day," Teet Soorm, finance director of Rakvere, told Reuters in an interview.
Rakvere is listed on the free market of the Tallinn stock exchange, and is the largest meat products processor in Estonia.
"By the end of the year we expect our total exports to grow to 40 tonnes per year," he added.
The company's forecast 1997 turnover is 670 million kroons and it is expecting a 12 million kroons 1997 profit.
The company does not have a representation in Lithuania as yet but after the establishment of the Riga sales point they expect to begin work on Lithuania.
"After we have finished the Riga project we will start in Lithuania and we expect to be operational there by early summer," he said.
The company has started its move to the Ukrainian market as part of the EFTC group. The EFTC group has holdings in most of Estonia's large food processors.
"As a member of the EFTC group, we are using EFTC's representation in Ukraine to start to market our products there," he said.
